issue_request: FHIR-17606 is a Published/Persuasive technical-correction issue for the Infrastructure and Messaging work group. It asked editors to use the attached Archive.zip QA review files to check whether updates from an earlier QA process had been applied; the Jira resolution was Auto-approved and the issue is marked applied for R5.
initial_application: No current source reference, git commit message, or history search result explicitly mentions FHIR-17606, GF#17606, #17606, or the issue title. The only explicit 2018 QA-report source commit found for this Jira family was applied #17600 and touched MolecularSequence/sequence files for a different work group, not INM artifacts.
additional_context: The actionable details are only in Jira attachment 15602, which returned HTTP 403 for both the secure attachment URL and the REST attachment-content URL in this environment. A 2021 INM minutes page references FHIR-17606 as 'Fix QA items from 2018 in STU3' and asks whether it is still relevant, with offline review requested, but it does not record the archive contents or a specific source change. Jira search shows a family of separate 'QA reports' issues for different work groups, so this seed should not be expanded into sibling QA report archives without their own investigation. Zulip search found no direct FHIR-17606 discussion that clarifies the requested changes.
reconciliation: No source file was changed. The reconciliation published an empty human-review audit commit because there is no bounded, verifiable build-scoped source location or semantic correction to apply without the archive contents.
